notes: «أَبِی ره» is the compiler's father with no name: relation link (rule 7)
«عَنْ رَجُلٍ مِنْ أَهْلِ رِقَّهَ يُقَالُ لَهُ أَبُو الْمَضَا»: the text names him, so the link is أَبُو الْمَضَا, not the unnamed رجل (rule 8)
«قَالَ لِی رَجُلٌ» is a second, unnamed transmitter of the Imam's words, kept in its place
The Imam speaks inside the story, so he is the last link (owner ruling 5)
